info.title: Clappia Universal API
info.description: Create forms, workflows, dashboards, and business apps with Clappia

post.description: Creates a new chart in Clappia.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

chartIndex.description: Zero-based chart index where the new chart should be inserted.

isStacked.description: Whether the chart should be stacked.

direction.description: Chart direction, such as Horizontal or Vertical.

aggregationDimensions[].description: Aggregation dimension objects that define the chart metrics.

dimensions[].description: Dimension objects that define the chart grouping axes.

numberOfCols.description: Column count for option display layouts.

isEditable.description: Whether users can edit the field.

retainValues.description: Whether field values should be retained when relevant form structure changes.
